title: Interfaces for coherent dualizing and enriched system operations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and positive quotients $A_{n+1}=R/\varpi^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use strict semilinear coefficient systems and their ordinary derived category and exact evaluations [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $p\ne\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism and $c=(j,p)$ a compactification [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-nagata-compactification]. The domain is the full category of normalized systems whose every finite evaluation is finite-Tor constructible, with no common bound [def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. Use the concrete unit [def-sf-finite-adjunction-coefficient-unit], its normalization [lem-sf-coefficient-unit-normalization] and finite-Tor levels [lem-sf-coefficient-unit-finite-tor] to define normalizedUnit. For a realization r define the mapping bifunctors using the recorded system global Hom. Enriched is the structure requiring invertibility of the actual internal transpose, a natural global isomorphism with r.globalMap components, finite enriched isomorphisms with the prescribed H-zero action, and the finite evaluation square. DualizingSpec is the predicate asserting a normalized finite dualizing tower, transition-compatible finite isomorphisms, its actual Roos triangle and projections, and the prescribed integral limit presentation. DualizingOperation consists of the regular-unit evaluation fixed on every section, a realization for the structure map, and DualizingSpec for its image of normalizedUnit. Its omega and finiteOmega are the existing explicit constructions. The structural trace is the absolute structural-counit transpose using a compact-support compositor. Duality requires system dual preservation, the system dual-formula isomorphism with its prescribed finiteFormula, finiteTrace and the unevaluated pairing identity. IntegralSupport requires reduction preservation and the functorial integral support comparison with its exact finite projections. These structures assert properties of supplied data and select no operations by existence.
